name: Kristen’s Enchiladas
notes: Consider doubling this, and putting a casserole in the freezer.

items: ¾ pound shredded cheese (cheddar, Monterey Jack)

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Melt in a saucepan: **2 Tbsp shortening**. Stir in **2 Tbsp flour**, **1 tsp chili powder** and **⅛ tsp garlic powder**. Add and bring heat through: **15 oz can enchilada sauce** and **15 oz can tomato sauce**.

steps.title: Brown the meat
steps.body: Saute in another pan: **1 pound hamburger**, **1 large onion, diced** and **1 can black beans** (optional).

steps.title: Prepare the tortillas and cheese
steps.body: Prepare: **1 dozen tortillas, corn or flour** and **¾ pound shredded cheese** (cheddar, Monterey Jack).

steps.title: Mix the creamy sauce
steps.body: Mix creamy sauce: **8 oz sour cream** and **1 can cream of chicken soup**.

steps.title: Layer
steps.body: Spray a 9×13 pan with oil, start with **¼ of the tomato sauce**. Layer with tortillas, sprinkle with the meat/onion mixture, then cheese. Repeat for 3 layers. Top with the creamy sauce and cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F until hot and bubbly, about 45 minutes.
